method: Rows are the players on the club's own A-League Men squad page (or, where that page lags, named under Ins or Re-signings in the league's 2026-27 transfer centre) who also appear in at least one independent 2026-27 list: ESPN's roster, Transfermarkt's 26/27 squad or FotMob's squad. Name and position text as the club prints them. group stands when an independent source puts him in the same group; otherwise it is the group two independent hosts agree on, else null. birthDate only where two independent hosts give the same date (the club pages print age, not date), else null. minutes2025_26 is A-League Men 25/26 regular season minutes from Transfermarkt club pages, summed over clubs, null when he was on none.
